what: Wave 1 of Project Cognitive Genesis on the reconciled tree (gen-rec1: the integration 3c2a3bc plus fix lanes A, B and C and the reconciliation). Cognitive benchmark (scripts/bench_wave1.py run, both splits; the withheld family NOT run, no --final): every Wave 1 setting off (diffed against the recorded genesis_baseline.json), as shipped, everything on, an ablation per registered component with the other settings as shipped, the idle curiosity path apart; the offline research benchmark and `nsf acceptance --all` against Wave 0 (15b0f03, its own source); the shipped defaults on a new individual. Learning progress ships off after lane B's rework (genesis_fix1b.json; its runs repeated on this tree with identical numbers). Earlier versions of this file are kept below, labelled.

scoring_corrected.what: re-review of the Wave 1 fix round, benchmark issues 1 and 2: the counterfactual headline answered_within_tolerance now counts every answerable question, the 4 front-door questions per seed included, and a decline of an answerable question is not within tolerance (before: the front-door questions were left out of the denominator, now answered_within_tolerance_without_front_door, a secondary figure); answered_within_strict_tolerance (scoring.STRICT_TOLERANCE = 0.05, added at the re-review, reported always) and max_relative_error beside it; `summary` pools the groups and is marked 'reported, not a claim' (summary_is). Every metric of every other family is unchanged from the previous version of this file (0 leaf differences outside the counterfactual family, timings excluded).

curiosity_remeasure.default: off: on the held-out wider seeds the timer path's realised bits per budget fall (0.139 -> 0.126)
